description: Prompt set for the self-generated part of Hessian corpus v2 (tools/quant2/gen_corpus.py, docs/quant2.md). Every prompt and every pasted passage was written for this corpus; none shares text with the held-out KL corpus tools/reference/kl_corpus/ (gen_corpus.py refuses one that does). Raw categories ask for a whole document in one reply with thinking off; chat entries are realistic requests whose rendered conversation, thinking included, is the calibration text. 'followups' holds the next user turn of a two-turn chat. 'max_tokens' is per turn and, with thinking on, must hold the thought (the template's default xhigh effort) AND the answer: a thought that does not close is rejected, so a thinking entry gets what the served 8192-token context leaves, turns x max_tokens + 1024 <= 8192 (gen_corpus.py checks it): 7168 for one turn, 3584 for two.
